Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class HomogeneousEquilibriumReleaseModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.HomogeneousEquilibriumReleaseModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReleaseFlowModel
public final class HomogeneousEquilibriumReleaseModel extends Object implements ReleaseFlowModel
Equilibrium isentropic short-opening model, maximizing rho*sqrt(2*(h0-h)) over pressure. Zero slip, no friction, heat transfer, solids or delayed flashing. It does not model pipe rupture. All flashes act on clones. Invalid physics or failed required flashes produce unusable results.

      private static SystemInterface phaseBoundaryEntropy(SystemInterface upstream, SystemInterface seed, double entropy, double pressure, double low, double high, HomogeneousEquilibriumReleaseModel.SolverDiagnostics solver)
      Resolves a cold-TP entropy discontinuity using an already observed vapour/liquid split. Candidate continuation never changes the EOS, components or equilibrium equations. The cold result remains the reference; a continued candidate must preserve its inventory, pass strict fugacity and phase checks, and have no higher Gibbs energy beyond floating-point noise.
